# Sanctioned examples of the RETIRED raw-install form, keyed by a hash of FILE +
# the command (whitespace-normalised).
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. TestNoRawCopyIntoInstallRoots forbids copying a binary
# straight over an install root. Without an escape hatch it would also forbid
# DOCUMENTING that form -- so nobody could write "do not do this: cp X <root>/X"
# in a warning, and the guard would prevent explaining the failure it exists to
# prevent.
#
# Deciding from surrounding prose whether a command is endorsed or prohibited is
# not something a regex can do (the same conclusion reached for apiKeyHelper
# mentions). So each sanctioned example is listed here instead, which makes
# adding one a deliberate act a human reviews.
#
# WHY FILE + COMMAND, NOT COMMAND ALONE. A text-only key would let one warning
# example authorise the same install command ANYWHERE in the repository, and
# moving the command out of its warning would still satisfy the stale check.
# Binding the exemption to a location means each site is reviewed on its own.
#
# To add an entry: run
#   go test ./internal/deploy/ -run TestNoRawCopyIntoInstallRoots
# The failure prints the command and the exact line to paste. Read it first --
# if it is real install guidance rather than a warning, fix the guidance.
#
# Stale entries fail the test, so this file cannot drift into fiction.

349bfa245488a4ae  # mk/install-go-bin.mk: the retired form, shown in its "do NOT use it" warning
